states.name: New York
states.subtitle: The Empire Route
states.completionText: Collect all 10 • Gold Foil State Stamp

designs.title: The Salt City
designs.lore: An orange-slice snow sun rises above Onondaga Lake while salt crystals catch the lake-effect light.
designs.history: Syracuse grew beside the salt springs around Onondaga Lake, earning its enduring Salt City nickname.

designs.title: Lake Effect Geometry
designs.lore: Art Deco geometry, Lake Erie waves, and a copper buffalo turn the Queen City into a bold printed monument.
designs.history: Buffalo's waterfront, monumental civic architecture, and famous lake-effect weather shape this issue.

designs.title: High Falls in Bloom
designs.lore: High Falls pours through a frame of lilacs, brick mills, and sunlit precision engraving.
designs.history: The Genesee River powered Rochester's early mills, while its Lilac Festival celebrates the city's spring color.

designs.title: Capital Current
designs.lore: The Hudson curves through an architectural blueprint of the capital's monumental forms.
designs.history: Albany is one of the country's oldest chartered cities and has served as New York's capital since 1797.

designs.title: Thunder in the Mist
designs.lore: Aquamarine water, pearlescent spray, and a luminous rainbow make the falls feel impossibly large.
designs.history: The Niagara River drops dramatically along the international boundary, creating one of New York's defining landscapes.

designs.title: Eleven Blue Ribbons
designs.lore: A glacial lake threads between patterned vineyard rows, a tiny dock, and deep-purple grapes.
designs.history: Long glacial lakes define this region of wineries, farms, waterfalls, college towns, and small waterfront communities.

designs.title: High Peaks After Dark
designs.lore: A silver moon, green night sky, solitary canoe, and loon ripple across a hand-cut wilderness print.
designs.history: The Adirondack Park protects a vast patchwork of public and private land, high peaks, forests, lakes, and communities.

designs.title: River of Hidden Shores
designs.lore: A lighthouse, castle, and launch navigate countless forested islands through an antique chart.
designs.history: The St. Lawrence River divides around hundreds of islands along the New York and Ontario border.

designs.title: Autumn Along the Hudson
designs.lore: A river bridge, orchard, shoreline train, and deep autumn color unfold like a romantic painted engraving.
designs.history: The Hudson Valley links river cities, orchards, historic sites, dramatic bridges, and forested highlands.

designs.title: Harbor After Dark
designs.lore: A suspension bridge, illuminated harbor, ferries, and a foil-lined skyline close the first route with electric energy.
designs.history: New York Harbor connects the city's five boroughs to a long history of arrivals, crossings, trade, and reinvention.

designs.title: Empire Route Gold Foil
designs.lore: An unnumbered Gold Foil issue awarded to every collector who completes all ten New York destination stamps.
designs.history: Across New York, ten distinct places become one finished route, preserved in gold as a record of the collector who found them all.
